summary: A 1935 60-ft tower was replaced in 1948 by an L-4 cab on an 82-ft timber tower on the Umatilla NF; it is staffed in summer, but the tower is closed to climbers.

facts.design: L-4 cab with catwalk on a treated timber tower

access.note: Summit reached by road; a gate on Road 62 may be closed, then park and walk. Sources say the tower is not open to visitors. Directory lists the site as accessible to the public.

visit.trail_note: Walk about 0.4 miles up Road 370 to the summit; if the Road 62 gate is closed, park on Road 62 and walk.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Umatilla National Forest

events.note: First lookout: a 60-ft wooden observation tower with a standard lookout cab.
September 1947 newspaper item announced a replacement 83-ft frame tower with a 14x14 house.
The 60-ft tower was replaced by an 82-ft treated timber tower with an L-4 cab.
Rex's says staffed until 2001. Forest Lookouts says a Forest Service inspection found the structure unsafe after May windstorm damage.
Cab removed, lowered by crane, refurbished and remounted on the tower; new roof, catwalk and handrail.
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register, October 21, 2004.
Listed as staffed and accessible to the public in the July 2026 directory.

corrections.why: 18.3 m (60 ft) is the height of the original 1935 tower. The present tower is listed at 82 ft (Rex's, Cheryl Hill), 87 ft (register) or 90 ft (Forest Lookouts). 25.0 m follows the 82-ft figure from two sources.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Present tower is 82 ft per Rex's and Cheryl Hill, 87 ft per the register, 90 ft per Forest Lookouts' 2004 entry. The story gives the range and the record uses 82 ft.

Rex's says staffed until 2001 and again from 2005. Forest Lookouts says a 2001 inspection found the structure unsafe. Cheryl Hill's 2021 visit and the July 2026 directory say staffed in summer. Current status is recorded as staffed.
Register gives 5,184 ft (1,580 m), which matches the brief's elevation_m. Rex's, Cheryl Hill and the directory give 5,229 ft. Not changed.

Brief coordinates are 45.8511, -117.7922. Register gives 45.85028, -117.78333; firelookout.org gives 45.85046, -117.78939. The sources differ by several hundred metres. Not changed; flagged for editor.

Directory marks the site accessible to the public (legal access to the site). The register's 2005 visit report and Cheryl Hill's 2021 visit say the tower is not open to climbing. Level set to restricted.

notes_for_editor: Height correction is the main fix to the brief (18.3 m is the 1935 tower). Heights for the present tower differ across sources (82, 87, 90 ft). Location and elevation differ between the brief and the register; not changed. The 1947 newspaper plan gave 83 ft and was not confirmed as built at that height. Walla Walla ranger district office or Umatilla NF recreation page not read; they may confirm current staffing and access.
